error.message: The disk filled while Knot wrote. The transaction or the file was not written.
error.fix: Free space on this Mac, then try again.

error.message: Another writer holds the store for longer than the busy timeout.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The store's database cannot be read.
error.fix: The store needs its owner: follow the troubleshooting guide.

error.message: The store was written by a newer Knot. This build does not open, change or delete it.
error.fix: Install a newer Knot.

error.message: The store is older than the `knot` tool, which never migrates.
error.fix: Open Knot, which migrates or repairs what the tool cannot.

error.message: A database at the store's path that Knot did not create, told by its `store_meta` row.
error.fix: The store needs its owner: follow the troubleshooting guide.

error.message: The store is not open yet, is migrating, or did not answer in time. Capture goes on into `Inbox/`.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: A write to the store or to a file failed for a reason other than a full disk.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: The app group's container is missing, so `StoreLocations` has no place for `Inbox/`.
error.fix: Reinstall Knot, whose installation lacks its shared container.

error.message: `KNOT_AGENT=1` is set and something asked for the milestone store (docs/architecture.md §7).
error.fix: Use the development build, knot-dev, and its own store.

error.message: An asset ID already holds a file with other content. A stored recording or drawing is never replaced, so the new file is refused and the stored one stays.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: A development build on the Mac names no worktree folder for its store, or one that is not safe as a folder name. Development builds from two worktrees never share a store.
error.fix: Build the development app from its worktree, which names the worktree's store folder.

error.message: The microphone permission was refused.
error.fix: Allow the microphone in the system's settings.

error.message: No input device is connected.
error.fix: Connect a microphone.

error.message: Another app holds the audio session.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: Too little free space to start a recording, so Knot refuses to start one.
error.fix: Free space on this Mac, then try again.

error.message: The disk filled during a recording or a drawing. The capture stopped with the stop cue.
error.fix: Free space on this Mac, then try again.

error.message: The conversion to the final audio format failed. The working file stays as the recording.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: A typing or drawing capture cannot start while a recording runs on this device.
error.fix: Stop the recording before typing or drawing.

error.message: The speech model is not installed yet, or is still installing. The recording waits, pending, and plays.
error.fix: Wait for the on-device model to arrive. Knot finishes the work by itself.

error.message: The recording cannot be read. It is kept, with no text. This is final, not a failure to fix.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device. The recording stays recorded and shows as kept with no text here, until another device takes the work. Final on this device.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: The transcriber returned an error, whose code `context.engineCode` carries. The recording is kept.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: The cleanup model is still downloading or not ready.
error.fix: Wait for the on-device model to arrive. Knot finishes the work by itself.

error.message: The device cannot use the cleanup model. The raw transcript is the final text.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: Cleanup declined: a refusal, a guardrail violation, an empty or malformed result, a result the guard rejected, text too long for the model, an unsupported language or an unsupported request. The raw transcript is the text, and `context.detail` says which.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: Cleanup took longer than its time allows. The raw transcript stays the text, and the job tries again.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: Handwriting recognition failed. The drawing is kept.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: The drawing's data cannot be decoded. No retry fixes it: the job ends, and the drawing is kept, shown as "Kept, no text".
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: The recogniser does not read handwriting in the language set. The job ends, and the drawing is kept, shown as "Kept, no text".
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: The system limits requests to the model for now. `context.retryAt` says when to try again, when the system gives a time.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The system limits its resources for now.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The app has no background time left.
error.fix: Open Knot, which migrates or repairs what the tool cannot.

error.message: The device is locked and the step needs it unlocked.
error.fix: Unlock the device. Knot finishes the work by itself.

error.message: The step runs only while the app is in the foreground, as recognition does (`docs/architecture.md` §10). It is not counted, and it runs when the app comes forward.
error.fix: Open Knot, which migrates or repairs what the tool cannot.

error.message: A step was cancelled: the task that awaited it was cancelled, because background time ran out or the queue was asked to stop. It is a yield: not an attempt, not a decline and not an error, and nothing from the step was saved.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: An inbox item cannot be read: its manifest, or a body that does not fit its kind, such as a file whose digest is not 64 hexadecimal digits. It becomes a failed segment that says so, and its files are kept in `Inbox/`. When a later version can read the item, it is stored where that failed segment is.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: An inbox item was written by a newer Knot. It becomes a failed segment that says so, and its files are kept in `Inbox/`. After an update that can read it, it is stored where that failed segment is.
error.fix: Install a newer Knot.

error.message: A manifest is larger than its bound.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: A file does not match the checksum its manifest or its record names: a file from the watch, which the watch sends again; a file placed in, or read from, the asset store; or a file the asset fetcher brought from another device, which is fetched again.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The watch link's session is not activated yet, or the iPhone is switching watches. The capture waits in the outbox.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The other side of the watch link is missing: the devices are not paired, or the other app is not installed. The capture waits in the outbox, shown as waiting.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The receiving side of the watch link, the iPhone, has no room. The capture waits in the outbox.
error.fix: Free space on the iPhone, which the Watch's recordings go to.

error.message: A transfer over the watch link did not complete. It is an attempt, and the capture is queued again.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The outbox file of a capture is missing or cannot be read. The capture fails at once, and its manifest is kept.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: The device is signed out of iCloud. Sync pauses and the notes stay.
error.fix: Sign in to iCloud.

error.message: The device signed in to another iCloud account. Nothing uploads before the answer.
error.fix: Answer, in Knot, whether to upload the notes on this device.

error.message: The notes were removed from iCloud. This device keeps its notes and pauses sync.
error.fix: Answer, in Knot, whether to upload the notes on this device.

error.message: A fetch would delete more than the set share of the local notes, so sync paused.
error.fix: Answer, in Knot, whether to upload the notes on this device.

error.message: A restored store waits for consent before it uploads.
error.fix: Answer, in Knot, whether to upload the notes on this device.

error.message: The network, the account or the service is not available for now, or the server limits requests. The engine retries by itself, and `context.retryAt` says when, when the server gave a time.
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: The server holds a newer version of a record. It is merged like a fetched record and sent again.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: A send found the zone missing: the user deleted it, or it went with a reset of the encrypted data. It leads to the zone-removed pause.
error.fix: Answer, in Knot, whether to upload the notes on this device.

error.message: A batch was over the server's limits. The adapter splits it and sends again.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: The user's iCloud storage is full. Sending stops until the person frees some, and the status says so. A retry after that is safe.
error.fix: Free iCloud storage, which is full.

error.message: A record is gone from the server. The rule of a long absence decides what follows (`docs/architecture.md` §11).
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: Any other error of the engine. No retry fixes it on this device.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: Text is longer than the door it came through allows, such as a title of more than 200 characters.
error.fix: Make the text shorter.

error.message: The same capture ID with different content.
error.fix: Use a new capture ID for new content.

error.message: A capture, or its end, that does not fit its kind: a body of another kind, a file whose digest is not 64 hexadecimal digits, a recording or drawing that starts with its file, a recording that ends stored with no file, or a negative content revision. `record`, `checkpoint` and `end` refuse it, and nothing was written. `setPeaks` refuses level peaks that `RecordingPeaks.isStorable` does not take, bytes of another format or more values than thirty minutes have, and nothing was written either. An inbox item that does not fit is `inbox_item_unreadable` instead.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: The segment or note changed since the revision the caller read.
error.fix: Read the note or segment again and use its current revision.

error.message: A revision from another store, or from before a restore of this one.
error.fix: Read the note or segment again and use its current revision.

error.message: A cursor from another store, or from another generation of this one.
error.fix: Read the changes again from the start, without a cursor.

error.message: A cursor ahead of the store's change counter.
error.fix: Read the changes again from the start, without a cursor.

error.message: No note or segment has that ID.
error.fix: Read the note or segment again and use its current revision.

error.message: The end of an ID given matches more than one note or segment.
error.fix: Give a full ID, or more of its last characters.

error.message: A capture was asked into a note that is deleted.
error.fix: Read the note or segment again and use its current revision.

error.message: The segment's capture is still open in the app, so it cannot be edited, deleted or moved.
error.fix: Wait for the capture to end in the app.

error.message: "Remove recording" of a segment that has no text yet. The recording is all there is, and its transcribe job still needs it; once the segment has text, the recording can go and the text stays (`docs/product-spec.md` §7).
error.fix: Try again a little later, unchanged.

error.message: A move of a segment whose capture is open.
error.fix: Wait for the capture to end in the app.

error.message: A move of a deleted segment.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A move of a conflict copy, which always stays with the segment it copies.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A move of the only live segment of its note, apart from its own conflict copies.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A return after the segment's note changed again since the move.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A return to a note that is deleted or gone.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A return with no move to undo on this device in the last 30 days.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A job was found running at launch twice. The process died inside it each time.
error.fix: Try again now.

error.message: A state machine was asked for a transition it does not have, or the store for a change its rules do not allow: `replaceText` with the typed origin, which only a capture's own saves write, a transcription run whose resume point is not after its start, or `setPeaks` on a segment that is not a voice segment, or that has no recording, none yet or one removed.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: A hotkey needs at least one modifier, or must be a function key.
error.fix: Choose another hotkey.

error.message: Another app already uses that key.
error.fix: Choose another hotkey.

error.message: An append window outside its range.
error.fix: Nothing is needed.

error.message: A command that takes text got none, or got text that is empty. Nothing was written.
error.fix: Read the usage, which knot help prints, and run the command again as it says.

error.message: The first word is not a command.
error.fix: Read the usage, which knot help prints, and run the command again as it says.

error.message: A flag or an argument the command does not take, one that lacks its value, a value it cannot read, or a required argument other than text that is missing. Nothing was written.
error.fix: Read the usage, which knot help prints, and run the command again as it says.

error.message: Command-line access is off on this Mac.
error.fix: The owner turns on command-line access in Knot's Settings on this Mac. The tool cannot turn it on.

error.message: A port of `AppEnvironment.unavailable`: its package has not filled it in yet.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.

error.message: Anything else. It carries a request ID once the logging facade records one.
error.fix: Report the problem with its code.
